name: Brook
description: A ultra clean Eleventy Blogging template

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run clean-prod && ELEVENTY_ENV=production eleventy && gulp sass && gulp minify-css && gulp dist-assets && gulp prod-copy && gulp inject-min-css && gulp purgecss && gulp minify-html && gulp copy-CNAME && npm run build:podcast-cards && npm run build:og
scripts.build:ci: USE_WEBP=true npm run build && npm run build:webp
scripts.build-dev: ELEVENTY_ENV=development eleventy && gulp dist-assets && gulp sass && npm run build:podcast-cards -- --dev-only
scripts.test:podcasts: node scripts/validate-podcast-shows.mjs && node scripts/validate-podcast-episode-template.mjs && node scripts/validate-podcast-social-cards.mjs && node scripts/validate-podcast-player.mjs && node scripts/validate-podcast-transcript.mjs && node scripts/validate-podcast-admin.mjs && node scripts/validate-podcast-member.mjs && node scripts/validate-podcast-checkout.mjs && node --check src/js/podcast-member.js && node --check src/js/podcast-checkout.js && node --check src/js/podcast-transcript.js
scripts.watch-dev: npm run build-dev && npm run sync
scripts.watch:server: npm run clean && npm run build-assets && run-p sync watch:all

author: Holger Koenemann
